pr.d: Frühmorgens in Kentucky: unmittelbar nach dem Start stürzt Comair-Flug 5191 ab, kaum einen Kilometer von der Piste entfernt - 49 Menschen sterben. Ermittler stellen fest, dass die Maschine von der falschen Startbahn abhob. Das wird untersucht.

Die neuseeländischen Grenzschutzbeamten kontrollieren drei israelische Männer, die große Mengen MDMA mit sich führen. Weiterhin stellt sich heraus, dass die Touristen sich auch anderweitig vergnügen: Sie verbringen ihre Urlaubszeit gerne in Sexklubs.

Der Versuch, Alkohol zu schmuggeln, wird von den Zollbeamten in den Häfen von Auckland vereitelt. Ein kurdischer Neuseeländer erzählt von seinen großen Abenteuern in Risikoländern und eine Französin gerät außer sich und in Rage.

Neuseelands Grenzschützer und Spürhunde überwachen Einreisende, Gepäck, Post und Fracht auf Schmuggelware und Biosicherheitsrisiken. Von Auckland bis Queenstown zeigt die Doku ihre akribische Arbeit zum Schutz der Inselnation.

Die Zollbeamten am internationalen Flughafen von Christchurch verdächtigen das Gepäck eines Kanadiers. Weiterhin bemerken sie ein ungewöhnlich farbenfrohes Päckchen aus Uganda. Schließlich belügt eine Philippinerin die Beamten.
Eine Brasilianerin verhält sich verdächtig. Ein Reisender gibt den Beamten einen hilfreichen Tipp.

Die Beamten fassen einen Chinesen, der mehr Zigaretten als erlaubt transportiert. Weiterhin verdächtigen sie eine Fracht mit Kupferdraht. Es stellt sich heraus, dass dort die Droge Crystal Meth versteckt eingeschmuggelt wird.

Im Jahr 1987 erschien der RUF CTR, das damals schnellste Serienfahrzeug der Welt. Etwa 30 Jahre später wurde der Nachfolger präsentiert: der CTR Anniversary. Die Geschichte des Oldtimers und die Entstehung des Supersportlers wird gezeigt.
pr.sub: RUF CTR Anniversary - Exklusiver als Porsche

pr.t: Legenden auf Rädern - Die Porschejäger aus dem Schwarzwald
pr.d: Weltweit jagen die beiden Brüder Röhrle aus Oberndorf im Schwarzwald nach seltenen Porsche-Modellen. Die beiden Porsche-Fans restaurieren sie mit großer Detailverliebtheit und liefern sie dann mit großer Leidenschaft aus.

pr.t: Europas größtes Autoterminal - Der Logistik-Gigant in Bremerhaven
pr.d: Die Reportage handelt vom BLG Auto- und Logistikhafen in Bremerhaven, dem größten Autoterminal Europas. Mithilfe digitaler Technik und einem erfahrenen Team werden jährlich 1.000 Schiffe abgefertigt und 1,2 Millionen Autos weltweit versendet.

Am Flughafen Berlin-Brandenburg befindet sich eine der modernsten Feuerwachen Deutschlands. Ein wichtiges Arbeitsinstrument dabei ist ein spezielles Hightech-Löschfahrzeug - entwickelt im baden-württembergischen Giengen.

Im bayerischen Donauwörth baut Airbus Helicopters Rettungshubschrauber für die Luftrettung. Für 2017 hat der ADAC elf neue H145 bestellt. Die Entstehung eines Modells und die Arbeit der Piloten, die Leben retten, werden dokumentiert.

Stoßzeit am Flughafen München: Ein Airbus A350 hebt ab. Das Langstrecken-Großraumflugzeug des europäischen Flugzeugherstellers soll seinem größten Konkurrenten, der US-amerikanischen Boeing 787 Dreamliner, den Kampf ansagen. Unter allen Verkehrsflugzeugen weist der A350 den höchsten Anteil an Kohlefaserstoffen in Rumpf und Tragflächen auf und setzt somit neue Stabilitätsmaßstäbe bei hohem Komfort. Zweieinhalb Monate dauert die Montage des Überfliegers. Kann Boeing da noch mithalten?
pr.sub: Die Super-Airliner - Flugzeuge für das neue Jahrtausend

pr.d: Gezeigt wird das alternative Nutzen von Passagierflugzeugen als Cargoflieger. Dies wird durch einen Umbau ermöglicht, und ist notwendig, da das Aufkommen an Luftfracht, sowie der Passagieranspruch an moderne Flugzeuge ständig steigt.

Die Demokratische Republik Kongos ist gespickt mit den Überresten einer sehr wechselhaften Regentschaft. Heruntergekommene Gebäude und ein zerfallenes Stadion gehen auf den alten Machthaber Mobutu Sese Seko zurück.

Das San-Juan-Gebirge im US-Bundesstaat Colorado ist ein Zeugnis von zerstörten Träumen des großen Geldes durch den Goldrausch. Auch der verlassene Ort Horse Sand Fort vor der Südküste Englands weist auf eine rege Geschichte hin.

Mitten in der indischen Metropole von Delhi befindet sich ein riesiger Dschungel, wo nur noch Affen und Schakale residieren sollen. Dort verborgen befindet sich eine Ruine, versteckt vor aller Welt. Es gibt einige Legenden rund um diese Ruine.

In der Nähe des Meerarms Firth of Forth in Schottland sind die Gebäude verlassen, aber sie deuten auf eine rege Geschichte der Geldwäscherei und der russischen Mafia hin. Eine Betonruine in Bulgarien sollte einst als feudaler Ferienort dienen.

An der Küste der taiwanesischen Insel Kinmen gibt es einen Betonblock oberhalb der Klippen, doch über den Zweck des Gebäudes ist erst an einem nahegelegenen Strand etwas zu finden. In Schottland stehen runde, fensterlose Türme aus der Eisenzeit.

In den Wäldern Kroatiens ist ein ominöser Turm zu finden. In der Zeit vom Zweiten Weltkrieg bis in die 1960er-Jahre hat die US-Regierung ein Gebäude am Rande des New Yorker Hafens für Transporte nach Europa genutzt.

Die Nazis sind besessen von der Idee einer deutschen Herrenrasse. Um ihre Ideologie zu festigen, suchen sie nach Anhaltspunkten in der Vergangenheit. Der Mythos der Stadt Atlantis und ihrer einst mächtigen Bewohner passt perfekt in dieses Muster.

Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
King Thistle wants bread for his royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes everyone to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Sandy's friends try to convince her that it is time to clean up, and helpful Whiff knows the perfect place for her old junk.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.
pr.sub: Paddington vs. the Seagulls; Paddington and the Light House

pr.d: Paddington leads a treasure hunt to find Captain Green Beard's loot. Everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition and enjoy a special ice cream prize, but teamwork is the key to success.
pr.sub: Paddington's Pirate Treasure Hunt; Paddington's Sandcastle Showstopper

pr.d: Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?
pr.sub: Paddington's Puffling Rescue; Paddington Goes Under the Sea

pr.d: The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.
pr.sub: Paddington's Beach Clean Up; Paddington's Holiday Farewell

pr.d: Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
Chickaletta is stuck on a runaway drone and butterflies cause chaos all around Adventure Bay.
The statue of Chickaletta has been stolen by Mayor Humdinger and is making its way through Adventure Bay's underground tunnel system.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.
pr.sub: Paddington Meets Paddingtron; Paddington's First Diwali

pr.d: Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Solar Eclipse; Paddington and the Mysterious Inventor

pr.d: The Browns have new neighbours and Tom is full of tales, like there's a goblin in the garden and her dad is an astronaut. Paddington, Jonathan and Judy decide to create a newspaper.
pr.sub: Paddingtons New Neighbour; Paddington Makes the News

pr.d: Tim and Tommy help out at the Diner Store, bringing some joy and chaos to the diner.
Tim, Tia and Tommy decide to put on a talent show, but they immediately stumble when they can't decide who should go first.
Tim and Kai worry they've ruined Rumblefest.
Nanny Plum conjures up a hamster called Pippin for the twins.
Queen Thistle decides to take a day off, so Holly, Ben, Nanny and the King have to look after the naughty twins Daisy and Poppy for the day.
Grandad is in Gran's good books for tidying his desk, but he tells Stan that it wasn't him! Who are the mystery tidy-uppers, and how did they get in?
When a penguin takes a shine to Stink's bed, and Grumblestunk decides to open a zoo, Brody is unimpressed, so Stan and Gran are forced to investigate!
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
pr.sub: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter

pr.d: The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom / The Pups have to save ancient relics when high jinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide

pr.d: Jade and Bobbi seek the Quake Crystal to calm the seas, but it is guarded by Ellie the giant eel. The twins enjoy a yes day with Uncle Steel, but when he says yes to being bad, things go wrong.
pr.sub: Quake Crystal Quest / Yes Day Disaster

pr.d: When the pups find kittens inside an old building, they think fast to bring the cats to safety before tearing the building down! / Motor's big drum performance in the symphony is almost ruined when the pups need to do loud demolition next door.
pr.sub: The Crew Demolishes A Soap Factory; The Crew Musically Demolishes A Building

pr.d: At the Farm Fair, a mysterious critter chews up everything in sight, and the pups must save the day! Later, Rocky dreams a sudsy accident turns Adventure Bay into a giant bubble bath, putting everyone at risk!
pr.sub: Pups Save the Farm Festival; Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!

pr.d: Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip. The Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
pr.sub: Pups Stop the Garboni; Pups Save the Porcupine

pr.d: Chitter becomes one of the good guys. Purple slime floods Sparkle Island.
pr.sub: The Real Chitter; The Slimy Suspect

pr.d: Tim, Tommy and Tia together get lost at a play centre.
When a storm keeps the Rexes at home, they must think of a game to pass the time.
Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid confronting Dad and telling him the truth.
Gabby and Pandy have some Christmas wishes, but first they need to help Figgy the Elf learn from her present-wrapping mistakes.
Santa Kitty is on his way to the Mermaid Christmas Cruise to give the first present of the year to MerCat's baby sister Hsiu Hsiu and everyone is invited.
When Leaf gets sick, the weather in the Smurf Village starts to go wild; when the Smurfs find a note from Gargamel begging for his mother because he's sick, they feel obliged to help him.
pr.sub: Leaf's Under the Weather; House Call

pr.d: Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Fixes The Observatory / The Crew Builds A Meow Yard

pr.d: Captain Gordy and his Space Shuttle are blasting off from the Adventure Bay Airport with a satellite. Mayor Humdinger sneaks on board to snap a couple of selfies.
When the Adventure Bay pot luck food goes missing, the Safety and Rescue pups deputise the whole community to track it down.

George has lost Mr Dinosaur. Mummy suggests they go to the police station to see if someone has handed him in.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Lucy and her dad are having a relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake, but it belongs to a mermaid who would like it back.
Ben and Holly visit the beehive to see how honey is made. Wise Old Elf is the beekeeper, and he proceeds to show the children his special way of collecting honey.
Miss Cookie's class is out on a nature trail, in the Little Kingdom! It is up to Ben and Holly to prevent the elves and fairies being discovered.
The fairy kingdom is left without food because there is nothing left in the treasure chest to pay the elves. As money doesn't grow on trees, King Thistle has to find a job.

Harold creates a ray that can freeze things instantly, it goes awry and sends a giant ice ball toward Adventure Bay; the Cheetah snatches half of Chase's Meteor Crystal, Chase must stop the Cheetah and restore his crystal.
pr.sub: Mighty Pups vs. the Big Chill; Mighty Pups vs. the Mighty Cheetah

pr.d: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan reads stories that make waves.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.
George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand-new clothes. After trying on lots of new exciting outfits George finds an outfit that suits him just right!

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.
Peppa and her family spend Christmas in Australia, on the beach with Kylie Kangaroo. Kylie has never seen snow, but she is given a special Christmas present: a snow globe.
Peppa Pig is excited on Christmas Day and so is Grandpa Pig who gets the biggest present.
At playgroup, the children, Madame Gazelle and with the help of Granny Sheep, create a giant Christmas card full of messages, drawings, and gifts to say thanks to Father Christmas.
Queen Thistle decides to take a day off, so Holly, Ben, Nanny and the King have to look after the naughty twins Daisy and Poppy for the day.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Nia gets a package from India containing a beautiful flower. When it starts to wilt, she must find a way to refresh the limp lily.
Kana wants to go extra fast, but Sodor's tracks are too twisty. To help, the engines lay some straight tracks that accidentally lead to a watery place.
Dora saves Swiper's nephew, Zorrito. Dora meets Sombrero, Boots' cousin. The three set off in search of the special blue bananas!
pr.sub: Side-Swiped / Quest for the Blue Bananas

pr.d: Tim attempts to distract Tia whilst Tusky is being washed in the machine.
Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip but soon disagree on what to do first.
The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.
Paddington leads a treasure hunt to find Captain Green Beard's loot. Everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition and enjoy a special ice cream prize, but teamwork is the key to success.
pr.sub: Paddington's Pirate Treasure Hunt; Paddington's Sandcastle Showstopper

pr.d: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Sandy's friends try to convince her that it is time to clean up, and helpful Whiff knows the perfect place for her old junk.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.
pr.sub: Paddington vs. the Seagulls; Paddington and the Light House

pr.d: Paddington leads a treasure hunt to find Captain Green Beard's loot. Everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition and enjoy a special ice cream prize, but teamwork is the key to success.
pr.sub: Paddington's Pirate Treasure Hunt; Paddington's Sandcastle Showstopper

pr.d: Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?
pr.sub: Paddington's Puffling Rescue; Paddington Goes Under the Sea

pr.d: The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.
pr.sub: Paddington's Beach Clean Up; Paddington's Holiday Farewell

pr.d: Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
Chickaletta is stuck on a runaway drone and butterflies cause chaos all around Adventure Bay.
The statue of Chickaletta has been stolen by Mayor Humdinger and is making its way through Adventure Bay's underground tunnel system.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.
pr.sub: Paddington Meets Paddingtron; Paddington's First Diwali

pr.d: Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Solar Eclipse; Paddington and the Mysterious Inventor

pr.d: The Browns have new neighbours and Tom is full of tales, like there's a goblin in the garden and her dad is an astronaut. Paddington, Jonathan and Judy decide to create a newspaper.
pr.sub: Paddingtons New Neighbour; Paddington Makes the News

pr.d: Tim and Tommy help out at the Diner Store, bringing some joy and chaos to the diner.
Tim, Tia and Tommy decide to put on a talent show, but they immediately stumble when they can't decide who should go first.
Tim and Kai worry they've ruined Rumblefest.
Nanny Plum conjures up a hamster called Pippin for the twins.
Queen Thistle decides to take a day off, so Holly, Ben, Nanny and the King have to look after the naughty twins Daisy and Poppy for the day.
Grandad is in Gran's good books for tidying his desk, but he tells Stan that it wasn't him! Who are the mystery tidy-uppers, and how did they get in?
When a penguin takes a shine to Stink's bed, and Grumblestunk decides to open a zoo, Brody is unimpressed, so Stan and Gran are forced to investigate!
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
pr.sub: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter

pr.d: The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom / The Pups have to save ancient relics when high jinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide

pr.d: Jade and Bobbi seek the Quake Crystal to calm the seas, but it is guarded by Ellie the giant eel. The twins enjoy a yes day with Uncle Steel, but when he says yes to being bad, things go wrong.
pr.sub: Quake Crystal Quest / Yes Day Disaster

pr.d: When the pups find kittens inside an old building, they think fast to bring the cats to safety before tearing the building down! / Motor's big drum performance in the symphony is almost ruined when the pups need to do loud demolition next door.
pr.sub: The Crew Demolishes A Soap Factory; The Crew Musically Demolishes A Building

pr.d: At the Farm Fair, a mysterious critter chews up everything in sight, and the pups must save the day! Later, Rocky dreams a sudsy accident turns Adventure Bay into a giant bubble bath, putting everyone at risk!
pr.sub: Pups Save the Farm Festival; Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!

pr.d: Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip. The Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
pr.sub: Pups Stop the Garboni; Pups Save the Porcupine

pr.d: Chitter becomes one of the good guys. Purple slime floods Sparkle Island.
pr.sub: The Real Chitter; The Slimy Suspect

pr.d: Tim, Tommy and Tia together get lost at a play centre.
When a storm keeps the Rexes at home, they must think of a game to pass the time.
Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid confronting Dad and telling him the truth.
Gabby and Pandy have some Christmas wishes, but first they need to help Figgy the Elf learn from her present-wrapping mistakes.
Santa Kitty is on his way to the Mermaid Christmas Cruise to give the first present of the year to MerCat's baby sister Hsiu Hsiu and everyone is invited.
When Leaf gets sick, the weather in the Smurf Village starts to go wild; when the Smurfs find a note from Gargamel begging for his mother because he's sick, they feel obliged to help him.
pr.sub: Leaf's Under the Weather; House Call

pr.d: Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Fixes The Observatory / The Crew Builds A Meow Yard

Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.

The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish there, Peppa must find a new friend for Goldie.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited. Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts. What can they be?
Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with, but not all the games are easy for little George.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
pr.sub: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World

pr.d: Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
It's a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play, but all the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.
George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Peppa and her friends are busy building a desert island in a sandpit. They are all very proud of it, with its forest, lake, houses and shops. It's going splendidly, until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.
It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
Baby Alexander is too young to talk until Peppa teaches him his first word.
Peppa and George realise that they have shadows and no matter what they do, they can't escape from them.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa wins her first star for making a wonderful drawing of her house. Dad realises that he has never won a single star and is determined to solve the problem.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.

Arnold lädt Lila zum alljährlichen Käsefest ein, weil er für sie schwärmt. Helga ist eifersüchtig und versucht, das Rendezvous zu stören. Harold findet sich selbst zu dick und fährt auf eine Kreuzfahrt. Dort werden spezielle Kinder-Diäten angeboten.
pr.sub: Das Käsefest; Schlank um jeden Preis

pr.d: The family prepares for war, AKA a trip to the local Asian market. After their battle to procure a rare cookie, Jack feels more part of the family. The Groom & Board gets a bad review. Lily tries to find the culprit and corr.

Helga wird von einem Modemacher entdeckt und ist nun das neue Model für Kindermode. Doch ihr gefällt der Job nicht mehr, da er zu stressig ist. Arnolds Freunde haben genug von seinen Ratschlägen und beschließen, nicht mehr zu machen, was er sagt.

Lil's favourite boba shop is closing! The kids try to save the café using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker. Lil and Min both realize how similar they are to their mums and set out to distinguish themselves.
pr.sub: The Boba--Get; Be Your Own Bean

pr.d: Big Bob und Opa geraten in einen Verkehrsunfall und beschuldigen sich gegenseitig. Ein Golfspiel soll entscheiden, wer die Reparatur bezahlen muss. Rhonda und Patty haben einen Streit in der Schule. Rhonda soll lernen, wie man sich richtig benimmt.
Alvin dresses Theodore up like a baby in order to impress the girl of his dreams. / While attempting to make a special present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos.
pr.sub: Baby Whisperer / Let's Make A Deal

pr.d: Arnold und Gerald besuchen eine Veteranengedenkstätte. Opa und Geralds Vater erzählen unglaubliche Geschichten vom Krieg und was sie für Heldentaten vollbracht haben. Doch die Jungs haben Zweifel, ob die Erzählungen wirklich wahr sind.

Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

Opa ist enttäuscht, weil er Arnold mit einer Matheaufgabe nicht helfen kann, da er nie die Schule beendet hat. Daraufhin beschließt er, seinen Schulabschluss nachzuholen. Die Kinder bekommen die Aufgabe, auf ein Ei aufzupassen. Dies endet im Chaos.
pr.sub: Das Abschluss-Zeugnis; Die Sache mit dem Ei

pr.d: Max finally declares his independence from his parents' house rules and moves to his friend's house, where they only rule is that there are no rules. However, ultimate freedom quickly becomes more than Max can handle.

Cousin Arnie kommt zu Besuch, doch Arnold findet ihn sehr seltsam, da eines seiner Hobbys ist, Lebensmittelpackungen auf ihre Inhaltsstoffe zu prüfen. Lila ist die Einzige, die ihn wirklich mag. Susie bekommt Besuch von ihrer Cousine Nancy.

Nearing their 100th save, Phoebe and Max are determined to make it their best and most memorable one yet. But by ignoring a series of small saves they overlook a super villain plotting revenge on his old rivals, Hank and Barb.

Helga beginnt zu schlafwandeln und ist immer auf dem Weg zu Arnolds Pension. Arnold und seine Familie nehmen an der TV-Show "Familienkämpfe" teil. Doch seine Familie blamiert ihn vor laufender Kamera und dann geraten sie auch noch in einen Streit.
Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally infects Charlotte, Henry, his family and even Ray. He quarantines them in Henry's house while he tries to find a cure.

Der Monkeymann hat Arnold vor einem schlimmen Unfall bewahrt, dafür will er sich bei ihm bedanken. Doch wo der Superheld steckt, weiß niemand so richtig. Außerdem macht Mr. Simmons einen Klassenausflug in die Schokoladenfabrik.
When Miss Shapen's niece comes into town and chooses Jasper over Henry, he discovers that she has much bigger plans in the works.

Opas Schwester meldet sich nach 70 Jahren und möchte Arnold kennenlernen. Doch der Besuch verläuft schwierig. Trainer Wittenbergs Karriere neigt sich dem Ende zu, doch Arnold hilft ihm eine Mannschaft für einen Synchronschwimm-Wettbewerb zu gründen.
The Twins go on a school camping trip and the Marsupilamis tag along, causing chaos. It's moulting season, and Twister's hairballs lead Stan to him!

SpongeBob möchte Muskeln haben, ohne zu trainieren, also bestellt er sich aufblasbare Arm-Attrappen, die alle beeindrucken, bis der Schwindel auffliegt, außerdem glauben SpongeBob und Patrick, dass sie Thaddäus mit einer Muschel umgebracht haben.

Perla bleibt keine andere Wahl, als mit SpongeBob zum Schulball zu gehen, aber dort angekommen, erweist er sich als hervorragender Tänzer. SpongeBob und Thaddäus kämpfen überdies eifrig um den Titel "Mitarbeiter des Monats".
pr.sub: Tanz' den Schwamm; Mitarbeiter des Monats

pr.d: Stan lures the Marsupilamis with the scent from his 100-year orchid, and manages to catch all three. Marcel steals Gran Gran's recipe book after tasting Jade and Mica's delicious sandwich.

Thaddäus Lieblingssendung wurde abgesetzt, und er beschließt, selbst eine Sendung zu drehen und SpongeBob wird beim Tanzen zufällig von einer Agentin entdeckt. Thaddäus ist neidisch auf SpongeBobs Erfolg und versucht, dessen Casting zu sabotieren.

Perla ist in der Krossen Krabbe und weint fürchterlich, weil ihre Begleitung für den Abschlussball abgesagt hat. Mr. Krabs sucht nach einem Begleiter für seine Tochter. Schließlich schlägt er SpongeBob vor. Doch Perla ist zunächst nicht begeistert.
Meteorite finds a nightclub in the forest. But it's a trap laid by Gargamel! Meteorite is going to have to save her friends.
Betrayed by Handy, Diaper Daddy is looking for a more loving family. Dwayne adopts him as a new toy.

Mr. Krabs Tochter erfährt einen Wachstumsschub und Mr. Krabs kommt kaum mit der Nahrungsmittelbeschaffung hinterher. SpongeBob bleibt in seiner Mangel stecken und seine Freunde versuchen mit allen Mitteln, ihn daraus zu befreien.
pr.sub: Der Wachstumsschub; In die Mangel genommen

pr.d: Dimwitty and Clumsy decide to get rid of the fire truck so that they no longer argue about it. But it is very difficult to put out a fire on foot. Gargamel leaves magic pebbles in the forest to hypnotise the Smurfs.
pr.sub: Fire Brigade on Foot; The Prettiest Pebble in the World

pr.d: Plankton landet per Zufall in Sandys Badezimmer und stiehlt ihren Pelz, um sich als Sandy auszugeben. Plankton soll in Mr. Krabs Kopf eindringen. Leider geht der Plan schief und Plankton landet stattdessen in SpongeBobs Kopf.
Theodore is passed over when Alvin and Eleanor train as lifeguards; Miss Croner's cherries are lost.

Als Plankton klar wird, dass Fett ein Geschmacksträger ist, bricht zwischen ihm und Mr. Krabs ein Wettstreit aus, wer das fettigste Mahl zubereitet. SpongeBob hört ein Telefonat von Mr. Krabs mit und glaubt zu hören, dass der ihn loswerden will.
pr.sub: Schmierige Schlacht; Ein Schwamm will nach oben

pr.d: The Munks help a world-famous runner design a pair of prosthetic legs for a race she's set to run in. Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, and he quickly realises it won't be easy.
pr.sub: Run Aimee Run; Theo vs. Simon

pr.d: Thaddäus wird wegen Umweltverschmutzung zu gemeinnütziger Arbeit verurteilt und dabei wird sein Ehrgeiz geweckt. SpongeBob möchte Gary mit einem Haustier eine Freude machen, doch der Spielkamerad entpuppt sich als mörderisches Untier.

Paper pretends to be an expert on cavemen athletics because no one could've possibly studied it before - only to meet an expert. Lou's cat, Meatball, is very sick, and he asks the trio to save him, so they help turn Lou's cat into a vampire.

Patrick und SpongeBob müssen sich ein Spielzeug aus dem Kindermenü teilen und geraten aneinander. Mr. Krabs ist derweil für den Preis der geizigsten Krabbe nominiert und SpongeBob soll bei einer Ansprache seine Knausrigkeit darstellen.
pr.sub: Deins, meins und meins; Knickerige Knauserkrabben

pr.d: Thaddäus verletzt sich beim Schlafen im Lagerraum, nun droht er Krabs mit einem Gang zur obersten Werktätigen-Sicherheitsbehörde. Derweil eröffnet eine neue Burgerbude in Bikini Bottom und Mr. Krabs und Plankton versuchen das Burgerrezept zu klauen.

Scissors meets his perfect romantic match, but she's a mermaid and he can't tell anyone about her. Rock accidentally shrinks Franz and himself while Paper and Scissors host a party to apologise to everyone they've wronged.

pr.d: It's time to restock the secret Krabby Patty ingredient, and it is SpongeBob's duty to make sure the ingredient is delivered safely to the Krusty Krab. Plankton has a customer who eats at the Chum Bucket every day.
Mr Krabs opens a dinner theatre at the Krusty Krab. SpongeBob takes his pals to Texas to see Sandy in a squirrel rodeo.
pr.sub: The Play's the Thing; Rodeo Daze

pr.d: The Star Family heads to their favourite resort in 'Gas Station Vacation', then in 'Bunny the Barbarian', Bunny goes on a midday adventure to a forgotten age.
pr.sub: Gas Station Vacation; Bunny the Barbarian

pr.d: Patrick hires more Patricks. Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products.
pr.sub: Too Many Patricks; Much Tofu About Nothing

pr.d: SpongeBob and Patrick bet who can hold a funny face the longest, then their faces freeze that way. SpongeBob and Patrick spend one last glorious, and dangerous, day at Glove World before it closes for good.
When a storm sweeps the Krusty Krab away, its crew and customers will need a crazed Krabs to lead them back home. Patrick's last baby tooth needs to come out, but he's afraid to let it go.
pr.sub: Mutiny on the Krusty; The Whole Tooth

pr.d: The Dinghy cabin camps overnight out of the water. Wilderness expert Paul Grunion visits the camp.
SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick are split up into separate cabins; Squidward has to earn back his morning "Reveille" duties.
In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw. After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
The Star family is a superhero team; Cecil works as a security guard at Lady Upturn's art museum.
pr.sub: Super Stars; Now Museum, Now You Don't

pr.d: The Krusty Krew get lazy when their mums take over the Krusty Krab. Patrick's new pet rock catches the eye of a mischievous rock collector.
SpongeBob works the grill at the toughest joint in town; Karen looks after Spot while Plankton goes out of town.
pr.sub: The Salty Sponge; Karen for Spot

pr.d: The Patricks battle for control of the TV; Upturn moves in with the Stars.
The Patrick Show gets competing sponsors; the star family visits King Neptune's palace.
pr.sub: The Patrick Show Sells Out; Neptune's Ball

pr.d: Squidina has to direct her school holiday play, but her script was mangled by Patrick.

Plankton closes the Chum Bucket and moves to a new town, but Mr Krabs suspects he's still up to no good. When SpongeBob accidentally picks up Neptune's magic trident, there's no telling what trouble he may cause.
Bubble Bass finds himself stranded with Patrick in a mysterious swamp, looking for a lost action figure; SpongeBob learns a new magic trick, but he can't find anyone to watch it.

When SpongeBob hides the secret formula in his home, it's up to Gary to protect it from Plankton. When a freak accident causes everyone in town to become as stupid as Patrick, Sandy must save the day.
Plankton steals Sandy's fur to disguise himself as Sandy and get the Krabby Patty formula. Plankton goes inside SpongeBob's head to get the Krabby Patty formula.
pr.sub: Someone's in the Kitchen With Sandy; The Inside Job

pr.d: When SpongeBob suddenly becomes the richest citizen of Bikini Bottom, he finds himself surrounded by lots of new friends. It's the day of Squidward's big lead solo audition with the Bikini Bottom Men's Choir, and Squidward is brimming with excitement.
SpongeBob accidentally punches himself in the face leaving behind a hideous black eye but is too embarrassed to tell anyone the truth. Plankton has brainwashed Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy.
pr.sub: Blackened Sponge; Mermaid Man vs SpongeBob

Thomas' Taten belasten Elizabeth. Sie steht unter Hausarrest und muss sich beim Verhör durch Lord Dudley rehabilitieren. Lord Somerset muss sich nach den Taten seines Bruders dem wütenden Kronrat und dem erschütterten König stellen.

Mit dem neuen Lord Protektor ist eine neue Zeit angebrochen. Edward, vom Einfluss seines Onkels Somerset befreit, ist ermutigt, noch rücksichtslosere protestantische Reformen durchzusetzen und neue Bündnispartner zu suchen.

Als der König erkrankt, sieht der Hof die Chance, von einem Katholiken angeführt zu werden, während Mary nach Whitehall reitet. Die Menschen haben allerdings die Katholiken zum Feind erklärt. Wegen ihres Bruders sind Mary und Elizabeth kurz vereint.
pr.sub: Zum tod müssen wir uns bücken

pr.d: Eine Explosion, in die eine geheimnisvolle Frau verwickelt ist, der Watts nachgeht, führt Murdoch zu einer geheimen Gemeinschaft.

Als in der Zeitung Chipping Cleghorn Gazette ein Mord angekündigt wird, ist das Dorf in Aufruhr. Die Bewohner fragen sich, ob es sich um einen harmlosen Scherz oder einen ernsten Fall handelt. Sie wollen herauszufinden, wer die Anzeige platziert hat.

Das Leben geht weiter, auch ohne die tödlich verunglückten Patriarchen. Die Verwerfungen bei den Leitners und den Hubers halten jedoch an. Die Fehde zwischen den Bergbauern-Clans droht wieder aufzuflammen und auch innerhalb der Familien kriselt es.

pr.t: The Straight Story - Eine wahre Geschichte
pr.d: Die wahre Geschichte des 73-jährigen Rentners Alvin Straight handelt von seinem Roadtrip auf einem Rasenmäher. Er fährt auf diesem 300 Meilen (ca. 483 km), um seinen kranken Bruder, der einen Schlaganfall erlitten hat, im Krankenhaus zu besuchen. Die beiden hatten wegen eines Streits seit zehn Jahren keinen Kontakt mehr miteinander. Nun will Alvin das Kriegsbeil endlich begraben. Seine Reise hält ungewöhnliche Abenteuer für ihn bereit.

Die Wahrsagerin Madame Rubina prophezeit Julia, dass sie ihren Ex Sergej Raihmann schon bald wiedersehen werde - den Mann, der sie um 250.000 Euro betrogen hatte und mit Schulden und Baby Ellie vor einem Jahr hat sitzen lassen. Julia befragt die Wahrsagerin, weil sich der Unternehmer Gerhard Schaller von ihr betrogen sieht. Johannes wollte den lästigen Fall loswerden und auch Julia ist nicht begeistert von dieser Ermittlung.
Zu ihrer eigenen Überraschung wird Julia Klug zur Hauptkommissarin befördert und teilt ab sofort das Büro mit ihrem Ex-Chef Johannes Sonntag. Der ist darüber alles andere als begeistert.

Horst Kopke, der Besitzer des bekannten Oldtimer-Autohauses Kopke Original, wird bei dem Einwurf der Tageseinnahmen tödlich von einem fahrenden Auto erfasst. Wurde er Opfer eines Unfalls mit Fahrerflucht oder eines geplanten Mordes?

Der arrogante Schönheitschirurg Dr. Schubert wird in seiner Praxis von dem Proleten Mike Boll attackiert. Der vorbestrafte Boll ist wütend, weil seine Freundin Doreen über Schmerzen klagt, seit Schubert ihr ein Gesäß-Implantat eingesetzt hat.

Die Frau des Teestubenbesitzers Ismail Yildiz wird von dem Gemüsehändler Ömer Dilek entführt. Das behauptet zumindest eine Augenzeugin. Oder hat sie sich getäuscht? Die Familienmitglieder beider Parteien wollen nicht an ein Verbrechen glauben.
No description available · EPGTalk.com

Monsieur Claude Verneuil und seine Frau Marie haben so einiges mitgemacht, seit ihre vier Töchter ausgesprochen multikulturell geheiratet haben. Trotz aller anfänglichen Schwierigkeiten haben sie sich mittlerweile mit ihren Schwiegersöhnen glänzend arrangiert. Monsieur Claude hat sogar deren Heimatländer besucht. Mit dem Familienfrieden ist es jedoch vorbei, als die Töchter ihren Eltern mitteilen, dass sie Frankreich verlassen wollen. Claude setzt alles daran, das zu verhindern.

Amanda und Max sind schlussendlich wieder zusammen. Sowohl Max als auch Madsen sind besorgt darüber, ob Max den Architektenwettbewerb gewinnen kann. Weyse rettet währenddessen im letzten Moment die Hochzeiten von Aurland und Frigh.
pr.sub: Die Karten kommen auf den Tisch

pr.d: Es ist Herbst geworden. Edward Weyse wurde beim Theater gefeuert. Er wird von Amanda angesprochen, die eine Stelle als Assistentin bei dem selbstverliebten und mürrischen Filmregisseur Gerhard Flügelhorn hat.

Der Sommer 1931 beginnt und die Gäste kehren zurück ins Hotel. Frau Andersen lebt nun bei Fies Vater und Fie ist die Leiterin des Hotels. Amanda und Max haben inzwischen geheiratet und Weyse wurde vom Theater suspendiert.

Fiese Schwester Anne taucht aus dem Nichts auf. Gefeuert von der Frau des Pfarrers, beginnt sie im Hotel zu arbeiten, macht aber viele Fehler - einer erhört Weyses Gebete. Währenddessen trifft Ditmars deutsche Cousine ein.

Jesper hängt Fie immer noch hinterher, aber sie hat inzwischen kein Interesse mehr an ihm. Mitzi drückt in einem Gespräch ihre Liebe zu Hitler aus. Madsen macht Geschäfte mit Morten. Frigh jagt eine junge Schauspielerin.

Poirot und Ariadne ermitteln in einem neuen Fall. Dafür tauchen sie in die Vergangenheit ab. Denn dort müssen sie die Wahrheit über zwei mysteriöse Todesfälle ans Tageslicht bringen, die einen rachsüchtigen Mörder in der Gegenwart beflügeln.
Als im Wald eine verweste Leiche gefunden wird, entdeckt Ridley eine Verbindung zu einem Fall.
Als eine weitere Leiche gefunden wird, wächst der Druck bei Ridley, den Mörder zu finden.

Ein inszeniertes Krimievent wird zur bitteren Realität, als der Hauptdarsteller in der Rolle des Detektivs erstochen aufgefunden wird. Um einen drohenden Medienrummel zu verhindern, muss Janie diesen Fall nun so schnell wie möglich lösen.
Eine Explosion, in die eine geheimnisvolle Frau verwickelt ist, der Watts nachgeht, führt Murdoch zu einer geheimen Gemeinschaft.

Der Tod einer professionellen Rollschuhläuferin wirkt zunächst wie ein Unfall. Bei seinen Ermittlungen stößt Murdoch auf Rivalitäten im Wettkampf und er findet sich alsbald in einer Welt von gnadenlos ehrgeizigen jungen Frauen wieder.

Doch zu welchem Preis ist dies geschehen? Erzählt wird die Geschichte einer technologischen Revolution, die unser Leben fundamental verändert hat – im Guten wie im Schlechten.

Wenn der Frühling wärmeres Wetter und längere Tage bringt, beginnt die Brutzeit in ganz Schottland. Otter, Seeadler, Papageitaucher und Schneehasen gehen auf Partnersuche. Schon bald müssen sie alle hungrigen Nachwuchs versorgen und sie großziehen.

Der Sommer ist endlich in Schottland angekommen und bringt längere Tage und eine Fülle von Lebensmitteln. An Schottlands Westküste lernen zwei Seeadlerjungen das Fliegen, und ihre große Schwester kennt beim Futter keine Gnade.

Es ist Herbst in Schottland und die Uhr tickt. Wenn das Tageslicht abnimmt und das Wetter abkühlt, schwinden auch die Nahrungsressourcen. Die Tiere müssen entweder jetzt migrieren oder sich auf den langen Winter vorbereiten.

Schottland erlebt einen ungewöhnlich warmen Winter. Für die Tiere ist das oft ein Problem. Ohne Schnee sind zum Beispiel die weißen Schneehasen nicht getarnt und werden zur leichten Beute der Adler. Für Eichhörnchen bringt das Wetter aber Vorteile.
