pr.t: Moksgm'ol: The Quest for the Spirit Bear
pr.d: A forest that lives off fish, a white bear that is not a polar bear, and wolves that feed off the ocean. Canada's Great Bear Rain Forest is a strange and pristine world, a land that time almost forgot.

pr.t: The Gentle Bear Man of Emo
pr.d: Michael finds that the bonds he forges with the bears and other wild animals that live on his property in Emo, Ontario, helped heal his soul after a tragedy. His relationship with the animals put him on a path to love and redemption.

pr.t: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
pr.d: Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska.

pr.t: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
pr.d: The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mum and her three cubs.

Summer in Yellowstone is a time of warmth and light; more than any other season, it brings an abundance of life to the park, from flowering plants and insects to hungry grizzly bears, curious coyotes and herds of elk.

Fall is a season of change in Yellowstone; the park bursts with vivid colours; some of its residents take advantage of the last few remaining lazy days of summer, while others prepare for the snowy season ahead, including finding a mate.

The jaguar is the third largest of the big cats, and pound for pound, the most powerful. This jaguar patrols a home range of over 100 square kilometres in Brazil, deep in the heart of the world's largest tropical rainforest.

Our film journey begins in Alaska's west. We are hoping to find glacier bears in the glacial regions of the Katmai National Park on the Douglas River. At the end of July, brown bears have now arrived to fish for salmon. In the surrounding forests, grizzlies look for berries and fresh, green twigs. The Katmai is Alaska's most volcanic area, and with 15 active volcanoes it is a veritable powder keg, surrounded by glaciers. In the Hook glacier region moose and lynx accompany us.
The reef life, and the birds, lizards and reptiles that cope with the lava rock islands of the Galápagos, make this remote series of islands a unique natural habitat.
pr.sub: In the Grip of the Ocean

pr.d: The Galápagos Islands are home to animals that have made adaptations, including penguins, iguanas, tortoises, cormorants and - possibly the oddest - the vampire finch.

High in the mountains, over 10,000 feet up, an unlikely champion stands: the whitebark pine. This resilient tree sustains life, providing food and shelter for animals like the grizzly bear, red squirrels and more.

Chile's coast runs 2,600 miles and boasts extraordinary diversity and an abundance of wildlife, from pumas to blue whales. In the Patagonian steppes a cougar mother plays tenderly with her cubs.
From record-breaking mountain ranges to massive rainforests, the variety of landscapes supports a seemingly endless diversity of wildlife.
Winter is by far the longest season of Yellowstone as well as its cruellest. Only the toughest and cleverest survive the cold, starvation and competition.

Winter slowly releases its cold grasp on Yellowstone, but spring is slow to arrive. The sun melts the snow and ice, waking the park and its residents from a deep winter slumber. With the thaw comes water, and with water comes an abundance of food.

The warmth of spring brings new life and energy to Yellowstone. Bears come out of hiding. Babies of all shapes and sizes explore their incredible new world. Every resident is eager to enjoy this magical time full of promise.

O reality show mostra um lado desconhecido dos participantes, que são testados em tarefas típicas do meio rural. Esses novos caipiras, que antes só faziam esforço físico na malhação da academia, têm que acordar com as galinhas, enfrentar o trabalho na roça e ainda provar que são inteligentes e fortes o bastante para aguentar as armadilhas de um confinamento. Eles têm que lidar com questões comuns ao meio artístico, como vaidade e opinião pública, além de temas bem pessoais, como amizade, amor, raiva e a saudade de casa.

Beim Besuch eines Feuerwehr-Museums spürt Theresa die Anwesenheit eines Mannes, der bei dem Terroranschlag im September 2001 ums Leben kam. Die Erfahrung inspiriert sie dazu, eine Gruppenlesung für Menschen mit gefährlichen Jobs zu veranstalten.

Theresa ist seit langem davon überzeugt, dass Menschen, die in ihrem Leben Fehler gemacht haben, dennoch ein Recht auf Frieden haben. Deshalb besucht sie ein Gefängnis und überbringt den Insassen Botschaften von ihren Hinterbliebenen.

Leigh und Matt erwerben zu einem günstigen Preis ein Haus. Die Restaurierung und den Umbau überlassen sie Jo und Chip und dafür stellen sie den beiden ein ordentliches Budget zur Verfügung, mit dem man etwas anfangen kann.

Tarek und Christina erhalten einen Anruf von ihrem guten Freund Carlos, der sein Haus verkaufen möchte. Die beiden wissen natürlich, wie man den Verkaufspreis durch ein paar Arbeiten erhöhen kann, und helfen Carlos bei seinem Projekt.

Tarek und Christina sind an einem Objekt in Torrance, Kalifornien, interessiert. Die Immobilie hat eine Komplettrenovierung nötig und der Kauf könnte ein Fehler sein. Doch die beiden gehen das Risiko ein, denn Torrance ist ein beliebter Ort.

Tarek und Christina besichtigen eine vielversprechende Immobilie in Santa Ana, die allerdings auch einen hohen Preis hat. Aus Erfahrung wissen die Makler jedoch, dass der erste Eindruck täuschen kann, und sind zunächst misstrauisch.

Tarek und Christina sind an einer Immobilie in Anaheim interessiert. Das Haus würde vermutlich einige Investoren anziehen, doch während der Besichtigung wird den beiden klar, dass sie wohl mehr Geld als erwartet investieren müssten.

Tarek und Christina sind an einem eher heruntergekommenen Haus in Chino, Kalifornien, interessiert, das zu einem Schnäppchenpreis zum Verkauf steht. Allerdings wäre es auch eine Herausforderung. Nun müssen sie sich entscheiden.

Michaella, deren Hochzeit in einem irischen Schloss stattfindet, sucht bei Kleinfeld das passende Kleid. Doch ihr siebenköpfiges Gefolge hat unterschiedliche Meinungen und das Budget ihrer Mutter ist begrenzt.

Radiomoderatorin Ashlee aus Boston träumt von einem Kleid wie aus einem Märchen - langärmelig, prinzessinnenhaft und trotzdem sexy. Doch mit ihrem meinungsstarken Gefolge im Schlepptau wird die Suche bei Kleinfeld zur echten Herausforderung.
Chip und Joanna renovieren das Haus der Familie Sandvall und konzentrieren sich auf die Waschküche.

Die Kundin der Gaines will ihr Leben neu aufbauen, nachdem sie ihr Haus und ihren Mann verloren hat. Sie hat sich drei Immobilien ausgesucht. Alle stehen in einer Gegend, die nach einer schweren Explosion gerade wieder aufgebaut wird.

Im Zuge der Familienplanung ist das Ehepaar Jonklaas auf der Suche nach einem Haus mit viel Platz. Dabei stehen drei Immobilien zur Auswahl: ein 60er-Jahre-Haus, eine alte Farm mit großer Anbaufläche und ein Haus mit wenigen Schlafzimmern.

Die Design-Expertin Joanna gestaltet ein 100 Jahre altes Haus für die Familie Herrera um. Dabei soll der Ursprungscharme der alten Immobilie bestehen bleiben. Gleichwohl sollen modernere Bauelemente und Ideen miteinfließen.

Über mehrere Staffeln erschufen Joanna Gaines und ihr Ehemann Chip echte Traumhäuser. Joanna erlaubt dem Zuschauer erstmalig Einblicke hinter den geistigen Schöpfungsakt und weitere Prozesse. Sie zeigt, wie sie Kundenbedürfnisse befriedigt.

Braut Bayleigh, bekannt aus der Reality-Show Big Brother, sucht gemeinsam mit ihrem Verlobten Swaggy und ihrer Familie bei Kleinfeld nach dem perfekten Hochzeitskleid für ihre Traumhochzeit auf den Bahamas.
Randy Fenoli blickt von zu Hause aus auf eine außergewöhnliche Staffel zurück. Bei Kleinfeld wird jeder Braut ihr Wunsch erfüllt.

Die Stylisten helfen Sandi Bogle, die am liebsten Kleidung mit Pailletten und Glitzer trägt. Dies ist jedoch schon längst aus der Mode gekommen. Stattdessen wird die junge Frau nun schlichter gekleidet. Ein Reality-TV-Star provoziert Skandale.

Paulette will sich als Marketing-Managerin wohlfühlen, während Paul seinen Biker-Look loswird. Die beiden Kandidaten wünschen sich ein vollständiges Makeover ihres Outfits und lassen sich in zehn Tagen von den Profis äußerlich aufpolieren.

Gail arbeitet täglich auf ihrem eigenen Hof und wünscht sich ein jüngeres Äußeres. Während ihrer Arbeit fühlt sie sich Jahre gealtert. Auch Sarah will sich etwas Gutes mit diesem Experiment tun und unterzieht sich dem Beauty-Makeover.

pr.d: Bianca Stratford ist das beliebteste Mädchen an der Schule und jeder hätte gern ein Date mit ihr. Doch ihr Vater erlaubt ihr nur auszugehen, wenn ihre ältere Schwester Kat auch ein Date hat und mitkommt. Ihre Schwester ist allerdings weniger attraktiv. Um das Herz von Bianca zu erobern, engagiert der Schönling Joey den ebenfalls rebellischen Patrick, der gegen Bezahlung mit Kat ausgehen soll. However, money is tight and in order to keep his family afloat, devoted nurse Greg takes a second job working for a drug company. That development doesn't sit well with Jack, whose previous suspicions regarding his hapless son-in-law soon come back in full force after learning of this development.

Two inseparable best friends navigate the last weeks of high school and are invited to a gigantic house party. Together with their nerdy friend, they spend a long day trying to score enough alcohol to supply the party and inebriate two girls in order to kick-start their sex lives before they go off to college. Their quest is complicated after one of them falls in with two inept cops who are determined to show him a good time.

pr.t: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby

With his confidence shattered, the driver draws on the help of his father and some eccentric training techniques to claw his way back to the top.

When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high-school students, trading in their guns and badges for backpacks, and setting out to shut down a dangerous drug ring.
Two police officers begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.

Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favourite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down.

Bullied as a teen for being overweight, Bob Stone shows up to his high school reunion looking fit and muscular. While there, he finds Calvin Joyner, a fast-talking accountant who misses his glory days as a popular athlete. Stone is now a lethal CIA agent who needs Calvin's number skills to help him save the compromised US spy satellite system. Together, the former classmates encounter shootouts, espionage and double-crosses while trying to prevent worldwide chaos.

Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss and can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective, and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.
A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

Wealthy businessman, Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.

When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

Albert is neither the most attractive nor the most confident man in the world, so when he falls in love with one of his firm's clients, Allegra Cole, he calls in an expert to help him win her over. Hitch is the business name of Alex Hitchins, and he earns his pay by teaching men how to woo the girl of their choice.
The body of a woman is discovered in a restaurant, and police immediately start to fear her death could be linked to one that occurred just 24 hours earlier.

Set to his most beloved songs is the epic musical story of Elton John, from his breakthrough years in the 1970s to his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar and pop icon.

Based on a true-crime story about teenage con man Frank Abagnale Jr, who cashed fake cheques worth over $2.5 million while disguised as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer, all the while chased by an FBI agent who is determined to catch him.

Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.

Set to his most beloved songs is the epic musical story of Elton John, from his breakthrough years in the 1970s to his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar and pop icon.
Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

A neurotic ant struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

pr.t: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
pr.d: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.
On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

pr.t: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
pr.d: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

The story of a reclusive green ogre called Shrek whose life of solitude is disrupted by a horde of refugees who have been banished by the evil Lord Farquaad. Determined to save his home, Shrek cuts a deal with the tyrant, who sets him a daunting task - if Shrek is ever to enjoy peace and quiet again, he must rescue Farquaad's bride-to-be from a dangerous castle. A DreamWorks animation.

Ogre Shrek and his new wife Fiona are surprised to discover a letter from her parents, inviting them over for dinner. Fiona is eager to show off her new husband, but her parents don't yet know she's an ogre. Taking Donkey along, they set off for Far Far Away to visit them, but the trip is hampered by the jealousy of a wicked fairy godmother and her hired assassin, Puss in Boots. A DreamWorks animation.

Shrek is just starting to settle down in his beloved swamp with his wife Fiona, but their mucky bliss doesn't last for long as word arrives that the ogre's froggy father-in-law is about to croak. The very last thing Shrek wants is to become King, but with no other heir in sight, it looks like the grumpy green one is destined never to live quietly in the swamp again. A glimmer of hope appears in the form of heir Artie. A DreamWorks animation.

Looking for the days when he felt like a "real ogre", Shrek makes an ill-advised pact with Rumpelstiltskin. Banished to a Shrek-less version of the land of Far, Far Away, the unfortunate ogre must once again win the love of Princess Fiona if he's to ever get back home. A DreamWorks animation.

War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.

Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.
A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.
Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.

Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.

Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.

pr.t: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
pr.d: Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.

pr.t: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
pr.d: The intrepid explorer Indiana Jones sets out to rescue his father, a medievalist who has vanished while searching for the Holy Grail. Following clues in the old man's notebook, Indy arrives in Venice, where he enlists the help of a beautiful academic, but they are not the only ones who are on the trail, and some sinister old enemies soon come out of the woodwork.

Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.
A hotshot rookie stock car driver sets his sights on the professional NASCAR circuit and the prestigious 🏁 [NASCAR] Daytona 500.

Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

A shy student becomes a crime fighter after a bite from a mutant spider, during a school outing, gives him extraordinary powers. As he comes to terms with his new-found abilities, he is also forced to contend with a maniac villain known as the Green Goblin.

When a failed nuclear fusion experiment results in an explosion that kills his wife, Dr. Otto Octavius is transformed into Dr. Octopus, a cyborg with deadly metal tentacles. Doc Ock blames Spider-Man for the accident and seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Spidey's alter ego, Peter Parker, faces fading powers and self-doubt. Complicating matters are his best friend's hatred for Spider-Man and his true love's sudden engagement to another man.

Life is sweet for Peter Parker, MJ loves him, her career is taking off and Spidey-mania is sweeping New York. However, when an alien parasite bonds to his suit, it's not long before the good times and Spidey turn bad. While his ugly ego is taking centre stage, MJ is dumped from her Broadway show, Harry remembers Spider-Man's role in his father's death, and Peter is consumed by revenge.

Peter Parker runs the gauntlet as the mysterious company Oscorp sends up a slew of supervillains against him, impacting on his life.
After his experience with the Avengers, Peter returns home to his Aunt May. But when a new villain emerges, everything that he holds dear is threatened.

A few weeks into their van life adventure, a young couple witnesses an accident that leaves the driver dead. Soon, they're being pursued by a demonic stalker who's impossible to outrun and follows them wherever they go.

Bad dreams haunt 15-year-old Gwen as she receives calls from the black phone and sees disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp. With help from her brother, she must now confront a killer who's grown even more powerful in death.

A deep space transporter crash-lands on a desolate planet circled by three suns. Among the survivors are pilot Carolyn Fry, mystic Abu 'Imam' al-Walid, cop William J Johns and convicted criminal Richard B Riddick, and their first thoughts are of survival and escape. Then Fry finds out that the planet suffers a total eclipse every 22 years, which is when the hibernating, flesh-eating inhabitants awake and hunt.
A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

Hilarity and horror ensue when toothy, carnivorous aliens escape from their space prison, pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.

Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.
A group of friends must confront their most terrifying fears when they awaken the dark powers of an ancient spirit board.
A séance scam leads to terror when an evil spirit possesses a widow's youngest daughter in 1967 Los Angeles.

When the Federation receives a distress signal from planet Vulcan during a hearing to decide whether Kirk has cheated on his final test at the academy, his friend Dr McCoy sneaks him aboard the USS Enterprise as it sets out on its maiden voyage.
A reprogrammed killer cyborg arrives in Los Angeles to protect a future leader from a shape-shifting assassin.
When all but one child from the same classroom mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.
Three ghosts give a greedy network executive a long-overdue attitude adjustment over the Christmas period. Based on the Charles Dickens classic, 'A Christmas Carol'.

When a CEO tries to close her hard-partying brother's branch, he and his chief technical officer must inspire their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and save their jobs.

Two army buddies who have become entertainers travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest. However, on arrival they find the resort, run by their old army commander, in need of a helping hand. There's only one answer, to put on a show.
As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.
It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas! From Nativity! to Office Christmas Party, get into the festive spirit with this week's Christmas laughs Cinema List!

George Bailey has so many problems he is thinking about ending it all - and it's Christmas! As the angels discuss George, we see his life in flashback. As George is about to jump from a bridge, he ends up rescuing his guardian angel, Clarence - who then shows George what his town would have looked like if it hadn't been for all his good deeds over the years.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.
As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.

Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

A primary school teacher, who was once a failed actor in a former career, is given the task of directing the school's Nativity play, which doesn't have a positive track record. Attitudes change, however, when it transpires that a Hollywood producer is coming to film the play.
Following Adam and Emma on their daily commute from the village of Langton to London, where they meet the same passengers every day.
Identical twins Abigail and Charlie travel to Wales to manage a bookshop for Christmas. Romance and mistaken identity follow as two local men woo the sisters, unaware they are twins.

Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.

Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.

A former black ops commando fakes his death for a quiet life in Boston. Finding himself face to face with Russian gangsters, he comes out of his retirement to rescue a young girl whose life hangs by a thread.

Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins, who will stop at nothing to destroy him.

Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

A former CIA assassin continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a 'Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, the man spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.
Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels.

It's been ten years since Jason Bourne walked away from the agency that trained him to become a deadly weapon. Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

A murder in Paris' Louvre Museum and cryptic clues in some of Leonardo da Vinci's most famous paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery. For 2,000 years a secret society closely guards information that -- should it come to light -- could rock the very foundations of Christianity.

Having ruffled the feathers of the Catholic Church with his controversial investigations into Christian history, a Harvard symbologist is surprised to be approached by the Pope's emissaries for help. Following the Pope's recent death, the four candidates most likely to take the pontiff's place have been kidnapped by a mysterious organisation known as the Illuminati.
An amnesiac symbologist and a doctor race across Europe and against time to stop a madman from unleashing a virus that could wipe out half of the world's population.
After Matty kicks Blaire from his house after finding out about her drug business, she attempts to bribe the family into letting her stay.
Ted and John's plan to exact revenge on the school bully inadvertently puts them in a parental role, while Matty agrees to get a colonoscopy on one condition.
Ted and John go to extraordinary lengths so that John can watch his first adult film, while Matty and Susan's disappointing night out leads Susan to question their relationship.
Comedy musical duo Flo & Joan make their highly anticipated return to the stage, armed with a piano and percussion section.

pr.d: From New York City's Town Hall, Marc Maron explores getting older, antisemitism, faith and the superiority of having cats over children; he opens up about the loss of his partner in 2020 and reestablishing his relationship with his father.

After a series of uncharacteristic messages, Sabi and Aqsa head home to check in on their mum, prompting Sabi to bare their truth to extended family. Finally ready to visit her own mum, Violet calls on 7ven for help.
After shocking news, Sabi takes some time to process what Bessy's accident has meant to them, but their absence soon causes loved ones to worry.

Will's boyfriend Matt is reluctant to admit his sexuality to his macho business associates, so tells them Will is his brother. Meanwhile, Karen is horrified to learn that Will helped draft her husband's charity-friendly will.

When Will sells Grace's late uncle's car to a nun, Grace has a change of heart and decides she wants it back, but the nun's not keen to give it up. Meanwhile, Karen's equally eccentric friend makes a play for Rosario's services and Jack is under the impression that his absent father is African-American.

Will's dad is in town. Will thinks it's him that he's visiting, but Grace sees him on the arm of a woman. She's unsure whether to tell Will and when she asks Karen for advice, Karen gets the wrong end of the stick and, thinking that it was her husband Grace suspected, sets off on his trail with Jack.
Grace is shocked when she catches Will's philandering father (Sydney Pollack) on the arm of a glamorous stranger (Lesley Ann Warren).
Will wants to break up with his annoying boyfriend but likes his dog too much, and Grace falls for Karen's nephew, but Karen is desperate to stop them getting together.
When Shred wallows over Emily's blossoming relationship with Rick, Frank decides to cheer him up with a special adventure. The group is shocked to learn Victoria is in a green card marriage.

Shred's on the rebound, but Frank doesn't share his newfound enthusiasm for dating. Emily enlists the team's help beating Templeton's precinct in an animal adoption competition. And Patel stumbles on an investment opportunity.

Frank unearths an illegal animal smuggling ring. Shred's first night shift introduces him to the world of Furry parties. Victoria has a secret admirer. And Patel and Templeton get stuck working together for the day.

Frank is frustrated when Emily, who is a stickler for rules, accompanies him on an official Animal Control ride-along. Shred and Patel become owners of their flip house and want to celebrate by throwing a party.

When Emily hires expert dog trainer Roman Park to help with the kennel dogs, Roman ends up disrupting the office dynamics. Frank is challenged for his long-held union rep position by Patel. And Shred learns Bettany doesn't like him.
After a shocking incident at CrimeCon, Ava and Nathan probe Matt for the truth, Matt takes matters into his own hands, and Ruby forces Ava and Nathan out of their comfort zone.
Ava and Nathan attend a charity auction where new and old wounds are laid bare; Ruby gets closer to the truth; Ava does damage control.
A game-changing idea hits Nathan as he reckons with a devastating failure; Ava confronts her buyer; Matt pushes for a new, more hands-on approach.
With the cards finally on the table, Ava and Nathan must race against time to prevent a tragedy whilst Matt prepares to expand the operation.

Grace unintentionally meets Noah's daughter Katie. Will's mother Marilyn visits after the death of her beloved dog, but doesn't receive the emotional support she expects. Jack argues with his rec centre boss, Theo.
Jack convinces Will to not be himself and to act like someone silly in order to attract a handsome TV personality. Meanwhile, Karen enlists Grace to go with her to the club where Lorraine works.
Will, Karen, and Jack unknowingly take hallucinogens, which cause Will and Jack to wonder whether they're soul mates and have Karen giving her final performance as Mrs. Stanley Walker.

Will and Grace's plan to win over Will's new boss goes awry when he drops dead in their flat. Meanwhile, Estefan and Karen's mutual dislike puts Jack in full damage control mode at his birthday dinner.
Will holds a mock trial in an attempt to fix the rift between Karen and her stepdaughter. Grace and Jack start a diet together, but changing their eating habits proves harder than they thought.
On the heels of Casino Night, Michael inadvertently outs a gay employee, while Jim settles into life at the Stamford office as he adjusts to his promotion, new office, and life without Pam.
Michael and Dwight head off to Philadelphia to meet Jan for the Northeastern Mid-Market Office Supply Convention.
Michael is in trouble once again as Jan busts him for declaring it's 'Movie Monday' where everyone watches a movie and neglects work.

Michael's former boss dies, and he thinks the entire office should be grieving, even though most of the employees didn't work for Ed. Unfortunately for them, he insists they attend a grief counselling session.

When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high-school students, trading in their guns and badges for backpacks, and setting out to shut down a dangerous drug ring.

pr.d: Brett Goldstein, a comedian, writer, actor and swimmer, begins his next big adventure.

The body of a woman is discovered in a restaurant, and police immediately start to fear her death could be linked to one that occurred just 24 hours earlier.
When a Colorado grandfather vanishes, conflicting family stories lead police to uncover a dark betrayal beneath the concrete floor of his own basement.
When a beloved son vanishes after an online date, Georgia detectives follow a digital trail to catch a killer who uses romance to lure victims.
A seemingly ordinary family man becomes the prime suspect for police investigators when his wife, three young children, and mother-in-law are discovered brutally killed after attending church.
Two suspicious bags are taken away for a second look after sniffer dogs raise the alarm, plus a look at the precautions that officers take when they have to go off-site for a job.
Officers in Wales discover a car containing guns during a routine stop, and booze-fuelled brawls on Saturday night take the rapid response cops out of their cars and onto the streets.
Following the men and women who help keep motorists safe on the highways and byways of New Zealand.
Following New Zealand's highway patrol officers from around the country, as they keep an eye on the most heavily populated roads for accidents and issues.
A joyrider's smash puts lives at risk, an empty fuel tank gives traffic officers a headache, and heroes in high-visibility come to the rescue.
Giles and Roger call in for assistance when a driver races past them on the motorway, and Gareth and Finn the police dog are called to a scene where two drunk men are armed with weapons.
Buckle up. It's time for more thrills and spills from the world of driving - all caught on camera.
From distracted drivers to animals on the attack and an unmissable heroic rescue, join us for yet another session of 'Caught on Dashcam'.
Strap in for a brand-new episode of Caught on Dashcam, with more thrills and spills from the world of driving - all caught on camera!
A workman steals a dumper truck and rampages through the Norfolk countryside, and a thief steals two charity tins for sick children but makes a crucial error.
A deaf girl is traumatised when she wakes up to find burglars in her house, and carers get caught out by an ingenious plan when they rob a pensioner.
A burglar trying to steal laptops comes a cropper, while a Scottish corner shop owner is the victim of an armed robbery that leaves his daughter rushing to the scene and fearing for his life.
Get ready for jaw-dropping crashes, sporting wipeouts, and hilarious moments on public transport all caught on camera.
Six days after Matthew Manwaring and his daughter Alison vanish, police uncover a grisly scene at Benjamin Laing's home.

pr.d: In 2010, young kickboxing champion Niall Dorr was savagely beaten to death in Dundalk, Ireland. Detectives decides to use CCTV footage to get help to catch and convict his killer.

Das anstehende Schützenfest raubt Stromberg den letzten Nerv. Er schlägt außerdem vor, einen Gedenktag für die tote Erika einzurichten und das Chaos ist wie immer perfekt.

Eric hopes Dr. Lee is able to remove the giant growth from his behind; Breanna suffers from itchy dry skin she can't help but scratch; Michael makes jokes, but he knows the bump on his head is anything but funny.

Ein grausamer Doppelmord, eine freigesprochene Verdächtige und ein Haus, in dem die Toten keine Ruhe finden: 1892 wurden der wohlhabende Bankier Andrew Borden und seine Frau Abby mit einer Axt erschlagen.

Im Alexandra Centre in Inglewood gehen Jordyn und Johnny rätselhaften Phänomenen nach. Unterstützt von Geisterjäger Kenny stoßen sie auf die düstere Geschichte des Hausmeisters Joe sowie weiterer ruheloser Seelen. In Katakomben, Sporthalle und Heizraum hören sie unerklärliche Geräusche und verstörende Stimmen. Eine Solo-Erkundung im Kriechkeller bringt Jordyn an seine Grenzen. Die Jungs setzen Wünschelruten, Kerzen und eine Polaroidkamera ein und probieren sogar das Spielzeug des Teufels aus.

Robert has thousands of unique bumps on his arms that Dr. Lee has never seen. Alexis has a painful cheek cyst that oozes and has a pungent odour. Stuart's cluster of back bumps disgusts his wife, but thrills Dr. Lee.
Die paranormalen Ermittler besuchen eine Familie, die von einem bösartigen Wesen aus ihrem Zuhause vertrieben wurde. Ihr Unglück begann, als sie eine Puppe aus der Wohnung eines Messies mitnahmen.
Even after gaining confidence from losing weight, Victoria still needs her mum's approval on her dress. Meanwhile, Lauren and her mum disagree on styles of gowns.

Zak und sein Team durchqueren das kalifornische Death Valley, um ein geheimnisvolles, weitläufiges Gelände zu untersuchen. Fasziniert von der dunklen, kraftvollen Energie der Wüste, erforschen sie die vom Hochwasser und Feuer zerstörte Villa.
Despite a solid support network of her boyfriend and cousin, Tiffany finds it difficult to break the cycle of depressed eating when her two roommates don't help her.

Als die Silver Bridge in West Virginia einstürzte, kamen 46 Menschen ums Leben. Manche glauben, dass die Brücke vom sogenannten Mottenmann niedergerissen wurde, denn die legendäre geflügelte Kreatur wurde kurz vor dem Einsturz gesichtet.

Crystal vies for the perfect princess Pnina dress; Kelly searches for a Grace Kelly inspired gown in black; Deborah feels a connection to Princess Diana and is determined to have her own Royal Wedding of South Beach.

Cynthia's veil clashes with her dress causing mayhem, since her wedding is only one month away. Meanwhile, Passant is running out of time with a limited dress selection.

pr.d: Lisa hat das "Couponing" so perfektioniert, dass sie es schafft, nicht mehr als 200 Dollar monatlich für Essen auszugeben - für eine sechsköpfige Familie. Zeta plant eine Party mit 300 Gästen. Ihr Budget: 100 Dollar und eine ganze Menge Gutscheine.
Georgie struggles to balance life, work and family; Mandy worries about Georgie's wellbeing; Missy gets into trouble at school.

Erin aus Missouri ist eine leidenschaftliche Coupons-Sammlerin. Jede freie Minute ist sie auf der Suche nach einem Schnäppchen. Ihr einziges Manko: Organisation gehört nicht zu ihren Stärken. Auch Student Dominique muss sparen.

pr.sub: Secrets, Lies and a Chunk of Change

pr.d: Jeff aus New Jersey hat seine Sammelleidenschaft von der Familie geerbt. Jetzt soll sein Sohn das auch lernen. Erste Herausforderung ist ein erster Alleingang. Basketballtrainerin Kelly sieht nicht ein, den vollen Preis für ein Produkt zu zahlen.
When the guys agree to do something the girls like, Sheldon and Leonard end up having a confrontation.

Adrienne aus Alabama ist Pfarrerin und Gutscheinfreak. Sie erzählt ihrer Gemeinde von den Vorteilen und spornt sie an, es ihr gleichzutun und Gutscheine zu sammeln. Doch so einfach ist das nicht und auch ihre Freundin Meagan traut dem Braten nicht.
When Sheldon becomes stuck in a rut with his work, the gang try to help him by raising his stress levels. Howard teases Raj with a game called Emily or Cinnamon.

Terrier-Dame Serrie ist plötzlich ungewöhnlich schlapp und hat offenbar etwas gefressen, das nicht ins Futter gehört. Dr. G geht mit dem Endoskop auf Spurensuche und entdeckt einen Pfirsichkern, der ausgerechnet am engen Magenausgang festsitzt.
After Leonard and Sheldon co-publish a physics paper, they must defend themselves against criticism from an online bully.

Gordita hat einen ausgeprägten süßen Zahn - mit gefährlichen Folgen: Die Hündin mopst eine ganze Tüte Schokostückchen vom Küchentresen und verputzt rund 270 Gramm. Dr. Suttie muss schnell handeln, denn die Dosis kann lebensbedrohlich sein.
pr.sub: Ein süßer Zahn und seine Folgen

pr.d: Wolowitz receives some shocking news as everyone prepares for the reopening of Stuart's comic book store.

Labrador Rudder hat eine Schwäche für alles Essbare, doch nach einer Portion fettem Speck streikt plötzlich sein Magen. Während Dr. Suttie nach der Ursache für seinen schlechten Zustand sucht, kämpft Zwergspitz Ti-Loup mit heftigen Niesattacken.

Sheldon and Penny agree to participate in an unusual experiment. Leonard, Amy, Raj and Emily spend the evening trying to escape a room with a zombie. Howard and Bernadette run into trouble at the airport.

Kätzchen Buffy hat sich beim Spielen ordentlich verheddert: Sie hat einen Faden verschluckt, der vom Magen bis in den Dünndarm reicht. Als Dr. Suttie die Schnur per Endoskop nicht sicher entfernen kann, bleibt nur die OP.

A trip to the pet store ends in a fight after Amy learns Sheldon has applied for a one-way mission to colonise Mars. Meanwhile, Leonard surprises Penny with a very adult purchase, and Raj gets into trouble when he snoops around Emily's flat.

Baron Dirty Colon hofft bei der Reality-Show From G's to Gents 100.000-Dollar zu gewinnen und seinem Leben eine neue Wendung zu geben. Doch dann nimmt die Show eine unvorhergesehene Wendung: Verbirgt Baron ein großes Geheimnis?
Tension arises when a magazine fails to mention Leonard in an article about the paper he co-wrote with Sheldon, and a blackout at Mrs Wolowitz's home leads to a final family dinner in her honour.

When Sheldon and Leonard are asked to speak at UC Berkeley, they take a detour in hope of meeting an idol. Meanwhile, Raj and Amy try to settle a dispute between Howard and Bernadette with a game of ping-pong.

Ein Laufstegmodel taucht tot auf dem Grund eines luxuriösen Pools auf: Zuvor lebte die junge Mutter wie in einem Märchen, Extravaganz dominierte den Alltag. Doch schnell deckt die Polizei auch die andere Seite der Medaille auf.
Sheldon and Amy build a blanket fort. Meanwhile, Wolowitz meets a half-brother he didn't know he had. Leonard and Penny have an argument in front of Wil Wheaton.

pr.t: Life of Baylen - Ich ticke anders!
pr.d: Eigentlich wollten Baylen und Colin nur eine Hochzeitslocation finden - doch plötzlich stehen Familienkonflikte, Paartherapie und eine völlig überdrehte Verlobungsparty im Mittelpunkt. Es wächst der Druck, endlich eine Entscheidung zu treffen.
Raj is asked to create a message in case alien life is discovered, and Penny is torn between auditioning for a movie or keeping her successful pharmaceutical sales job.

Wolowitz questions his engineering skills after he and Sheldon can't get a toy drone to fly. A cancelled flight puts Leonard's plans in jeopardy, and Raj sets his parents against one another after he's cut off financially.

pr.t: Life of Baylen - Ich ticke anders!
pr.d: Baylen und Colin wollen sich für ihre Hochzeit in Form bringen, doch ein klassisches Fitnessstudio kommt für Baylen wegen ihrer Zwangsstörung nicht infrage. Also muss eine kreative Alternative her. Die Lösung scheint Hobby Horsing zu sein, wo mit Steckenpferden galoppiert, gesprungen und trainiert wird, als stünde ein echtes Turnier bevor. Zwischen schweißtreibenden Übungen, peinlichen Erinnerungen und viel Gelächter testen die Verlobten ihre Fitness auf recht ungewöhnliche Weise.
When Sheldon's and Leonard's mothers finally meet, personalities collide. Howard decides to do his share of the chores with a little help from his friends.
Sheldon presses Leonard and Penny to choose a date for their wedding, while dealing with dramatic changes in his own relationship with Amy.
22 Kinder, ein Haus und garantiert keine ruhige Minute! Bei den Radfords, Großbritanniens kinderreichster Familie, ist schon der Alltag eine logistische Meisterleistung.
Sheldon struggles to understand what is going on with Amy. Penny must decide if she can get past Leonard's bad behaviour.
Leonard tries to ease Penny's mind, Sheldon plans a special episode of `Fun With Flags', and Bernadette feels bad about keeping a secret.
Jede Menge Kinder, drei Schulen und viele Morgenmuffel: Bei den Radfords wird der Schulstart nach dem Lockdown zur logistischen Großaktion.
A flat tyre during Leonard's bachelor party weekend in Mexico tests the guys' skills. Penny is compelled to tell her family that she and Leonard eloped.
An impending change to his living arrangements inspires Sheldon to revert to 2003, before he met Penny and Leonard. Raj and Howard form a band.

Das Gewicht der Geschwister Shantel und Carlton aus Columbus, Ohio, geriet völlig außer Kontrolle. Daher mussten sie zurück ins Haus ihrer Mutter ziehen, wo sich ihr jüngster Bruder um alles kümmert. Dr. Now in Houston stellt eine letzte Chance dar.
Barry Kripke expresses interest in Amy while leading a fencing lesson for the guys. When Stuart tries to attract female customers to the store, Penny, Amy and Bernadette help out.
Leonard and Sheldon go to great lengths to secure the helium they need during a nationwide shortage. Bernadette and Penny try to find Amy a new man on a dating app.

Sheldon struggles to keep his emotions in check when he is interviewed for a documentary about Spock. Penny and Leonard make a surprising discovery, while Wolowitz and Bernadette get into a disagreement about remodelling his childhood home.
Ed Gamble hosts as captains and Richard Ayoade and Joanne McNally debate outrageous views. Maisie Adam argues ditching the jury system.

Mit seinen fast 315 Kilo, ist Chuck inzwischen so dick, dass er im Alltag extrem behindert ist und auch sein Geschäft verkleinern musste, weil er die Arbeit nicht mehr bewältigen konnte. Chuck wagt eine riskante Operation, um normal leben zu können.

Colin Stafford-Johnson continues to transform his childhood garden into a haven for wildlife. Rain finally arrives and the garden is transformed - ponds burst with dragonflies and damselflies, meadows explode in flower and the much-awaited hum of life can be heard everywhere. As inquiries proceed, and her relationship with fellow officer DC Simon Waterhouse becomes increasingly fraught, she finds herself taking desperate steps to ensure the case doesn't fall apart completely. Crime drama, starring Olivia Williams and Darren Boyd

Part two of two. Simon and Charlie interview Ruth, who is forced to admit she was with Jason when fingerprint evidence places her in his house. But she insists she did not kill him, and only lied about being there because she was terrified of Aidan discovering her secret. Charlie begins to think they may have arrested the wrong person. But if Ruth isn't the killer, who is? Olivia Williams and Darren Boyd star in the crime drama

Classic thriller starring Margaret Lockwood and Michael Redgrave. One moment Miss Froy was sitting there, on the London-bound train from the Tyrol. The next she had vanished. Some passengers claimed she was never there, but Iris Henderson is convinced that she saw her. Was it her imagination?

Period black comedy starring Oliver Reed and Diana Rigg. Europe, 1906: the Assassination Bureau is a secret society that only kills people who really deserve it. A mysterious, beautiful woman decides to put out a contract - for the head of the bureau himself.

A bank manager plots to rob his own branch with the help of an aristocratic couple, but intends to double-cross them. The scheme gets off to a flying start - until his victims prove to have their own plans for the loot. Crime comedy, starring Stanley Baker, Ursula Andress, David Warner and TP McKenna

A British aristocrat finds himself captured by the Gestapo while attempting to assassinate Hitler, and is followed home by the Germans when he finally evades their clutches. Thriller, starring Peter O'Toole and John Standing

Beautiful, young socialite Iris Carr, bored with the raucous and unsociable behaviour of her friends whilst on holiday, resolves to seek out some tranquillity and travel home alone. Iris' expectations of peace are short-lived when, at the railway station, she suddenly faints. She wakes in time to be rushed onto the train, but with a pounding head and a feeling of being in a dream.

In 1906, a secret international club eliminates those they deem unworthy. Their leader, in an attempt to rejuvenate the group, challenges his assassins to target him, while he in turn will attempt to assassinate them. The scene is set for a cat-and-mouse chase across Europe, which is further complicated by the presence of a beautiful female reporter.

Tiny, Rocky, Mazu und Bill stellen sich vor, wie die Welt wäre, wenn sie tun und lassen könnten, was sie wollen und wann sie wollen. Schnell merken sie, dass man sich im Leben manchmal Grenzen setzen muss.

Bill gilt als der beste Schnüffler der Stadt. Als es ihm nicht gelingt, eine besondere Blume zu erschnüffeln, die Giganto hilft, mit dem Niesen aufzuhören, will er nicht zugeben, dass seine Superkräfte gefährdet sein könnten.

Oggy Oggys Aufmerksamkeit wird plötzlich erregt, als er einen unwiderstehlichen Geruch wahrnimmt. Es stellt sich heraus, dass dieser aus der Küche kommt, wo der Küchenchef gerade dabei ist, Fisch zu kochen. Oggy Oggy ist hin und weg.

Oggy Oggy verbringt dieses Mal einen sehr schönen Abend mit der Schäferkatze im Freien. Die beiden haben es sich im Gras gemütlich gemacht und schauen bei der Dunkelheit zum Licht der Sterne hinauf. Dort kann man einige Sternbilder erkennen.

Oggy Oggy trifft den Piratenkater an, als dieser gerade damit beschäftigt ist, sein Schiff zu putzen. Oggy Oggy will ihn von dieser Aufgabe befreien, indem er mit dem Piratenkater ein Picknick auf einer einsamen Insel macht.

Der Koch Pierre lädt die Freundesgruppe zu einem spannenden Abenteuer ein. Sie wollen gemeinsam Fischen gehen. Dabei wollen sie die Fische anschließend verarbeiten und im Lokal anbieten. Doch die Freunde retten die Fische stattdessen.

Milo, Lofty und Lark haben Schwierigkeiten, eine Idee für das Buchfestival in Milostadt zu finden. Doch die Kritiker loben ihre Superheldengeschichte über einen Tag voller Abenteuer, Spannung und Hühnern und ihre Geschichte hat einen großen Erfolg.

Milo ist sehr glücklich, denn er hat eine besondere Ehre bekommen. Er darf die Königin Mabel für einen gesamten Tag vertreten. Dabei soll er die Aufgaben der Königin erfüllen. Doch Milo lernt durch den Tag eine Menge dazu.

Peppa und Schorsch schauen sich ein Märchenbuch an. Wie gerne wäre Peppa selbst in einem Märchen! Doch Mama und Papa Wutz wollen endlich zu Oma und Opa Wutz zum Mittagessen. Und dann wollen sie auch noch zu Fuß gehen! Das findet Peppa so gar nicht märchenhaft, bis sie durch einen Park laufen müssen ...
Schorsch hat bei einem Ausflug seinen Dinosaurier verloren. Nun macht sich Familie Wutz auf den Weg zur Polizeiwache, denn sie hoffen, dass der Dino dort abgegeben wurde.

In der Spielgruppe dürfen heute alle sagen, was sie einmal werden möchten, wenn sie groß sind. Fast alle haben schon eine Idee, nur Peppa noch nicht. Zum Glück hat sie noch etwas Zeit, bis sie sich entscheiden muss.
Doktor Braunbär kommt in die Spielgruppe und zeigt den Kindern seinen Rettungswagen. Er erklärt, was man bei einem Rettungseinsatz alles beachten muss.

Alle hundert Jahre muss der Weihnachtsmann beweisen, dass er noch in der Lage ist, den Kindern auf der ganzen Welt Geschenke zu bringen. Unter den Augen dreier gestrenger Herren von der Weihnachtsmann-Gesellschaft muss er sich am Nordpol einem schweren Test unterziehen. Grantelbart versucht natürlich mit allen Mitteln dafür zu sorgen, dass der Weihnachtsmann die Prüfung nicht besteht …

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Die Paw Patrol öffnet die Türen der Kommandozentrale, um Kindern alles zeigen zu können. Ryder und das restliche Team führen die Kinder herum und zeigen ihnen ihre Ausrüstung sowie Maschinen und wie ihre Einsätze geplant werden.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Robo-Hund braucht ein neues Teil für seinen Schwanz. Ryder muss es mit ihm besorgen. Katie soll in der Zeit auf die Hunde aufpassen. Natürlich nutzt Bürgermeister Besserwisser die Situation aus und sorgt mit seinen Kätzchen für Ärger.

An Halloween stürzt sich Pumuckl begeistert auf die für die Kinder gedachten Süßigkeiten. Doch nach einer weiteren gierigen Naschattacke bekommt der Kobold einen hartnäckigen Schluckauf, den er einfach nicht wieder loswird.

Weihnachten steht in der Abenteuerbucht vor der Tür und Rubble träumt davon, vom Weihnachtsmann einen Laserbohrer zu bekommen. Doch Bürgermeister Besserwisser sabotiert die Feierlichkeiten mit dem gemeinen Plan, alle Geschenke an sich zu reißen.

In Zuckerstadt sollen laut Computer nur zwei Kinder Geschenke bekommen. Trixie glaubt, das da etwas nicht stimmen kann. Bald kommt sie dahinter, dass zwei dreiste Jungs den Computer des Weihnachtsmanns manipuliert haben.

Rudolph ist schwer krank. Dabei steht bald jedoch schon das Fest an. Der Weihnachtsmann überlegt, ob Rudolph dabei sein kann. Eines Morgens kann er seinen Augen nicht mehr glauben, als Rudolph nicht mehr im Stall bei den anderen steht.

Der kleine Simon hat sich ein Pony zu Weihnachten gewünscht. Doch Simon lebt auf einer Raumstation. Da der Weihnachtsmann nie einen Kinderwunsch unerfüllt lässt, ist klar, dass er auch diesen Wunsch erfüllen wird. Doch wie soll der Weihnachtsmann ein richtiges Pony in den Weltraum transportieren?

Leon ist enttäuscht vom Weihnachtsmann und kann andere Kinder schließlich dazu überreden, sich ihm anzuschließen und einen Boykott zu starten. Der Weihnachtsmann bekommt davon mit und möchte Leon und seine neuen Freunde stoppen.

Der Geschenke-Computer weist den Weihnachtsmann und seine Elfen auf ein Kind hin, das sich zu Weihnachten nichts gewünscht hat. Der Junge heißt Alex und lebt in Dollartown, der reichsten Stadt der Welt. Daraufhin statten der Weihnachtsmann und seine Elfen Alex einen Besuch ab und finden heraus, dass er zwar ein riesiges Zimmer und jede Menge Spielzeug hat, aber keine Freunde.

Andy liebt seinen Plüschhasen Schnüppi über alles. Sein Bruder Frank findet allerdings, dass Kuschelhasen nur etwas für Kleinkinder sind und wirft Schnüppi aus dem Fenster. Während Andy ganz verzweifelt ist, sendet das kleine Kaninchen Notsignale …

Chrissie ist eine hochtalentierte junge Eiskunstläuferin und Favoritin für die Weltmeisterschaft, die in Frostland ausgetragen wird. Als sie ihren Kristallglücksbringer verliert, fühlt Chrissie sich unsicher und will beim Wettbewerb nicht antreten.

Sven hat einen großen Weihnachtswunsch: einen fliegenden Teppich, mit dem er seinen Vater abholen kann. Der ist Archäologe und immer wieder in der Welt unterwegs - aktuell im Orient. Trixi und Jordi wollen seinen Wunsch erfüllen.
Der Weihnachtsmann und seine Elfen bekommen Besuch von einer Star-Reporterin.

Peggy wünscht sich einen Zauberstab, um ihre hässliche Nase zu verändern. Doch der Weihnachtsmann lehnt diesen Wunsch ab. Sein Widersacher Grantelbart kriegt dies mit und schickt Peggy einen fehlerhaft gebauten Zauberstab, der nur Chaos anrichtet.

Als einer der Briefe an den Weihnachtsmann durch einen Windstoß durch die Luft gewirbelt und fast von Jordi durch einen Feuerstoß aus seinem Flugscooter verbrannt wird, ist nur noch die Unterschrift lesbar: David. Trixi und Gilfi finden heraus, dass David den Wunsch hat, kleiner zu werden, weil seine Eltern nur noch Augen für seine jüngere Schwester haben. Doch dieser Wunsch kann nur mit einem besonderen Apparat erfüllt werden.

Die Kinder aus dem Dorf des Weihnachtsmannes wollen ihm etwas schenken. Gemeinsam mit den Elfen überlegen sie, was ihn erfreuen könnte. Ein Zufall kommt ihnen zu Hilfe: Grantelbart hat seinen Gehilfen Gugor dazu angestiftet, zwei äußerst gefräßige Termiten im Haus des Weihnachtsmannes auszusetzen. Diese beiden Tierchen haben nun ausgerechnet den guten Anzug aufgefressen …
pr.sub: Ein neues Kostüm für den Weihnachtsmann

pr.d: Der Weihnachtsmann lädt zum Weihnachts-Dankfest ein, das alle hundert Jahre stattfindet. Väterchen Frost, die Lichterkönigin Luccia, die Hexe Roxana und die Sternenstaub-Streuerin sind mit von der Partie. Der Weihnachtsmann zaubert mitten am Nordpol einen Strand und ein leckeres Büfett herbei. Grantelbart bekommt von der Feier Wind und ist erbost, weil er nicht eingeladen ist.

Torg und Zilka, zwei Kinder aus dem fernen Scomland, in dem es keine Elfen gibt, wollen gerne mehr über die geheimnisvollen Wesen wissen. Trixi, Gilfi und Jordi entwerfen ein elektronisches 3D-Buch für die Kinder und lassen es von der Spielzeug-Maschine herstellen. Leider sabotieren Grantelbart und Gugor ihr Vorhaben.

Gugor leidet unter Grantelbarts Gemeinheiten und wünscht sich einen mechanischen Doppelgänger, der all seine Aufgaben übernimmt. Obwohl der Weihnachtsmann zustimmen müsste, bauen Jordi und Trixi aus Mitgefühl vor Heiligabend einen eigenen Roboter.

Jordi baut einen Teleporter, mit dem man alles und jeden von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren kann. Er überredet die anderen Elfen und den Weihnachtsmann zu einer Testfahrt. Grantelbart, der das Geschehen beobachtet hat, manipuliert den Teleporter, der auch als Zeitmaschine dient, und die Freunde landen im Jahr 2222.

Kinshi ist verzweifelt, denn sie möchte unbedingt größer werden. Jordi möchte sie dabei unterstützen, indem er aus Pfingstrosenblüten einen Wachstumstrank mixt. Da er sich mit der Dosierung nicht auskennt, geht sein Plan nicht auf.

Die Elfen ärgern sich über den Balbo, der mit seiner Ungeschicklichkeit wieder einmal für Chaos in der Spielzeugfabrik gesorgt hat. Sie setzen ihn vor die Tür. Traurig beschließt Balbo, den Nordpol zu verlassen. Er verpackt sich selbst als Präsent und lässt sich per Post zu dem kleinen Pablo schicken, der sich einen Stoffbären gewünscht hat.

Seit zwei Wochen kommt kein einziger Brief mehr beim Weihnachtsmann an. Doch als er bei der Post nachfragt, versichert ihm diese, dass er sie höchstpersönlich gebeten hätte, seine Post an eine andere Adresse zu senden. Es stellt sich heraus, dass ein falscher Weihnachtsmann die Briefe unterschlagen hat. Ob die Elfen dem richtigen Weihnachtsmann dabei helfen können, den Betrüger zu entlarven?

Grantelbart möchte Weihnachten verhindern und entwickelt ein magisches Pulver, mit dem er die Geschenke zum Leben erwecken kann. Kurz darauf veranstalten diese sehr viel Chaos und das Weihnachtsfest ist somit nicht mehr sicher.

Sebastian ist ein kleiner unentschlossener Junge, der jeden Tag seinen Wunschzettel ändert. Deshalb stapeln sich schon Dutzende von unnützen Geschenken in der Spielzeugfabrik. Um Sebastians Unentschlossenheit ein Ende zu bereiten, sucht ihn der Weihnachtsmann höchstpersönlich auf - doch das hätte er lieber bleiben lassen sollen.
pr.sub: Sebastian weiß nicht, was er will

pr.d: Der Weihnachtsmann, der überall auf der Welt am selben Abend die Geschenke verteilen muss, hat ein Geheimnis: Dank der großen Uhr kann er die Zeit anhalten. Aber als der Weihnachtsmann und die Elfen mit dem Schlitten unterwegs sind, dreht Grantelbart den Verlauf der Zeit um und unsere Helden rasen geradewegs in die Vergangenheit.

Der Weihnachtsmann und die Elfen haben es geschafft, der Vergangenheit zu entkommen. Doch als sie gerade die Geschenke in der Gegenwart verteilen wollen, spielt Grantelbart schon wieder mit der Zeit. Der Weihnachtsmann muss sich beeilen.

Während Edie, Ernest und Randall ins Kino gehen, soll Arthur auf die kranke Bo aufpassen. Allerdings hält der nicht viel vom Kranksein. Er will lieber mit Bo trainieren. Dabei entdeckt Bo eine Mitbewohnerin unter ihrem Bett, die Hilfe braucht.

The great mountain ranges are some of the planet's most spectacular landscapes, but they are unforgiving places to live in. Only few pioneering animals have what it takes to endure at extreme altitude. Mountain animals are also amongst the most elusive in the world, yet this film provides unique and intimate glimpses into their secretive lives. Witness the moment four snow leopards come together when a mother and cub become trapped between two rival males.
Mountains: The wildlife documentary series with David Attenborough continues with a unique and intimate glimpse into the secretive lives of mountain-dwelling animals.

James May continues his epic quest to re-skill the modern male. A handcuffed James and Oz Clarke break out of Dartmoor prison and must navigate their way across the treacherous moors, with a team of trackers in hot pursuit and just an Ordnance Survey map and a compass to help them. James also builds a genuine slate-bed pool table, and turns his hand to portrait painting.

James and the team reunite a former teenage rock band and gets them to play their first concert in 20 years - in front of 5,000 unsuspecting festival goers. James also demonstrates his own axe skills as he fells a tree, makes toilet paper out of Richard Hammond's autobiography and learns how to tame his fears by going on a good old-fashioned ghost hunt in one of Britain's most haunted castles.

James takes to the catwalk to liberate men from the tyranny of fashion and promote the one item of clothing they'll ever need - a cunningly modified boiler suit. He also does his bit for the British space project by sending the ashes of a cat and a budgie 100,000 feet into the stratosphere.

pr.d: The fall of 1941 marks a crucial period for the Nazi program known as the Final Solution: the extermination of the Jews. At Auschwitz, new ways of killing are devised. Commandant Rudolf Höss orders the expansion of Auschwitz.

pr.t: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
pr.d: Deported Jews arrive in Auschwitz by the trainload, some from as far away as the British Isles. Prisoners not immediately sent to the gas chambers face other horrors in the camp.

pr.t: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution

Remote islands offer sanctuary for some of the planet's strangest and rarest creatures. The rare pygmy three-toed sloth enjoys a peaceful existence on an idyllic Caribbean island, while nesting albatross thrive in predator-free isolation. However, island life always comes at a cost. On the Galápagos Islands, young marine iguanas must escape an onslaught of deadly racer snakes the moment they hatch from the sand.
Islands: Wildlife documentary series presented by David Attenborough, beginning with a look at the remote islands which offer sanctuary to some of the planet's rarest creatures.

The great mountain ranges are some of the planet's most spectacular landscapes, but they are unforgiving places to live in. Only few pioneering animals have what it takes to endure at extreme altitude. Mountain animals are also amongst the most elusive in the world, yet this film provides unique and intimate glimpses into their secretive lives. Witness the moment four snow leopards come together when a mother and cub become trapped between two rival males.
Mountains: The wildlife documentary series with David Attenborough continues with a unique and intimate glimpse into the secretive lives of mountain-dwelling animals.
Two men battle it out in a sabre duel to resolve a dispute and there's a new invention to defeat the pesky wasp.

James May continues his epic quest to re-skill the modern male. A handcuffed James and Oz Clarke break out of Dartmoor prison and must navigate their way across the treacherous moors, with a team of trackers in hot pursuit and just an Ordnance Survey map and a compass to help them. James also builds a genuine slate-bed pool table, and turns his hand to portrait painting.

James and the team reunite a former teenage rock band and gets them to play their first concert in 20 years - in front of 5,000 unsuspecting festival goers. James also demonstrates his own axe skills as he fells a tree, makes toilet paper out of Richard Hammond's autobiography and learns how to tame his fears by going on a good old-fashioned ghost hunt in one of Britain's most haunted castles.

James takes to the catwalk to liberate men from the tyranny of fashion and promote the one item of clothing they'll ever need - a cunningly modified boiler suit. He also does his bit for the British space project by sending the ashes of a cat and a budgie 100,000 feet into the stratosphere.
A secretive underground base that concealed the power to destroy nations, and a sprawling industrial relic clinging to the edge of an unforgiving waterfall.
Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on nature's most amazing animals. Having a closer look at the vampire bat.

Gavin starts his new job in Cardiff and Stacey is thrilled to be at home again. The weekend brings with it a big reunion, as everyone meets up for the christening of Neil the baby, but how will Smithy react to news from Nessa that it is a double celebration?

Stacey is trying for a new job whilst ensuring that Gavin sticks to his recent promise, and Dave is not a happy bunny when Nessa tells him she is taking Neil the baby to Essex to see his dad. The response teams rush to save the life of a 21-year-old man who has been shot twice in the chest at a Doncaster pub. Another man has a seizure in the cab of his tipper truck.
The work of NHS emergency response teams. Staff are scrambled to a block of flats after an explosion causes multiple casualties and a driver is trapped after his lorry hits a tree.
The team joins the search for a missing aeroplane pilot and passenger. A man digging for antique bottles in a South Yorkshire tip is buried alive, leading to a desperate fight to save him.
A student climber plunges from a cliff face in Wharfedale and the team fears he has broken his neck. The medics are also called to treat the victim of a stabbing at a meat plant.
The medics spring into action when a cyclist plunges down a cliff in a freak accident. A homeowner's booby trap, designed to deter burglars, sparks a major rescue operation.
A landslip at a construction site traps a worker under tons of earth. Reports of a riot at a school come in, and medic Alex must lead the operation to treat the injured.
A car crash victim has to be put into an induced coma at the roadside. Andy is called in to stand by as bomb disposal experts deal with a mortar dating back to the Boer War.

The responsible son of a middle-class family crosses paths with the arrogant daughter of a wealthy businessman, leading to the lives of Ramachari and Charu forever being changed.
Malhar claims Pratiksha is his lover while she firmly denies it. Faced with a strict deadline from Ravi, Pratiksha must race against time to prove her innocence.
After verifying their horoscopes, the priest asks Jahaan and Ilah to get married within three days. Meanwhile, Maheep makes a vow to reunite Jordan and Ilahi.
Kapil wants a tantric to help get rid of Dadi's addiction to booze.
